create_knowledge_store_from_entries: create a KnowledgeStore initialized with a list of string entries or KnowledgeEntry objects
create_knowledge_store_from_files: create a KnowledgeStore that loads content from file paths or glob patterns on disk
insert_knowledge_entry: insert a string or KnowledgeEntry object into an existing KnowledgeStore instance
search_knowledge_store_as_string: search the KnowledgeStore and return all entries formatted as an XML-like knowledge string
search_knowledge_store_as_list: search the KnowledgeStore and return entries as a list of KnowledgeEntry objects with optional max length
